purpose: lapdMouseBrowser is a 3D Slicer extension that lets users browse the lapdMouse data archive, download dataset files (such as aerosol deposition volumes and lung models), and visualize airway tree structures and compartment measurements.
summary: lapdMouseBrowser is a well-implemented 3D Slicer extension providing browsing, downloading, and specialized visualization for lung anatomy and particle deposition data. Code structure follows Slicer conventions, packaging and license are correct, and safety/environment standards are fully met. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: Standard urllib usage over HTTPS, safe file operations, no unsafe code execution or telemetry without informed consent.

environment.rationale: No changes to Slicer's shared Python environment, no package installation at startup, no pinning or downgrading.

packaging.rationale: CMake setup builds and packages both modules and lists all required resources correctly.

license.rationale: Standard 3-clause BSD license included and referenced.

soundness.rationale: Well-structured scripted loadable modules adhering to Slicer conventions, with proper progress dialogs and error handling.

utility.rationale: Good documentation, repository references, and user instructions.

findings.title: Opening external files with write mode r+ unnecessarily
findings.suggestion: Change 'r+' (read/write) to 'r' (read-only) when opening external user files like *.meta tree structures.

not_checked: Full runtime execution inside 3D Slicer (verified via static code review of available scripts and CMake setup).
